title: The Prescription Drug $2000 Out-of-Pocket Cap Explained Simply
bigPicture: Starting in 2025, the most you will have to pay for covered prescription drugs in a year is $2,000.
whatYouNeedToKnow: Once you spend $2,000 on your covered medicines, you pay $0 for the rest of the year.
This limit applies to drugs covered by your Medicare Part D plan.
You can choose to pay your costs all at once or spread them into small monthly payments.
commonMistakesToAvoid: Thinking this covers every single medicine; it only counts drugs your plan agrees to cover.
Assuming you have to pay the full $2,000 upfront.
actionSteps: Check your current drug list to see which medicines are covered by your plan.
Ask your pharmacist or insurance provider about the 'payment plan' option to spread out your costs.
